R17, R28, R31: a busy home draws, in order, the strip, Needs you, Needs the group, each area at a glance, the projects, Since you last looked and What happened?
R17: controls: a reading at zero is not drawn, and an empty block is not drawn; a failed read is drawn failed in its block
R17, R11: a new member's first visit (lookedsince answers null) draws no Needs you and no Since you last looked
R23: the heading is the group's name, or "Your group" while none is set, never the slug
R40, R17, R23, R11: an unnamed new team's home is headed "Your team", leads with "Name your team" as its primary button and draws the other steps in order, then What happened?, nothing else
R1, R8: each project the member sees is a reference opening project, with its stage ladder Forming, Investigating, Matured, Closed

R8, R21, R25 (fix round 3, C14): each project's question count is its roster row's own, drawn with the project, picking the singular or plural key; a count at zero is not drawn; none is read project by project
R8: a project whose stage is null is drawn undetermined; a list answered truncated says more projects exist
R1, R17 (interface-shell R10): Home's reads drawn loading, failed or with data; an empty read draws no block
R17: an item's own acts on Home send their bodies and re-read the queue, never lookedsince
R1, R25, R30: "Start a project" sends promote with the member's title as a new forming project, written as its title, and opens project on success
R30, R80: the form asks the title and who can find it; neither choice is preselected; none chosen sends nothing and says so; choosing findable sends discoverable
R1, R25: control: with no title nothing is sent and the member is told in the screen's words; a refusal is drawn beside the act
R1 (interface-shell R12): "Start a project" is drawn only to a session that may contribute
R9, R14, R40: "What happened?" draws each door startfrom answers as a button, the sixth door last; a door left out is not drawn
R40: pressing a door sends startfrom for it and opens its offer in place; no script name is drawn before that
R14, R16: with no script offered, the sixth door alone is drawn, so the section is always drawn; its press opens elsewhere, starts no script and sends nothing
R9: startfrom failed is drawn failed in its block; startfrom is a drawn act once it answers doors with scripts
R9: a door's script starts in the wizard runner (cs.wizard) at its version, and sends nothing
R9, R23, R40: beside the doors, the blank start, "Start a project" opening its title field on press; no free-text box and no matching work
R29: a project the member is invited to is hers to do on Home, with Join (projectjoin), as the project's participants answer her place; a joined project offers none
R28: a to-do names its subject by its title, a reference, and its act by the act's label; a subject with no title draws the untitled word
R31: a reply owed by another side whose date has passed is drawn "no reply recorded", never "overdue"; the strip counts no item as overdue
R34: every key Home reads is a word of the list, and what it draws for a sample of its keys equals word(key, vars)
R29, C74: a project the member is invited to is one row on Home though the queue holds its invitation too; an invitation the list does not know is drawn from the queue
R29, C96: two invitations draw two distinct labels, each naming its project

tests: R17: Home reads the queue, projectlist, startfrom, lookedsince and groupidentity; to an administrator also memberlist, bootstrap, profiles, grouplanguages and aiuseovertime (group)
R17, R28, R31: a busy home draws, in order, the strip, Needs you, Needs the group, each area at a glance, the projects, Since you last looked and What happened?
R17: controls: a reading at zero is not drawn, and an empty block is not drawn; a failed read is drawn failed in its block
R17, R11: a new member's first visit (lookedsince answers null) draws no Needs you and no Since you last looked
R23: the heading is the group's name, or "Your group" while none is set, never the slug
R40, R17, R23, R11: an unnamed new team's home is headed "Your team", leads with "Name your team" as its primary button and draws the other steps in order, then What happened?, nothing else
R1, R8: each project the member sees is a reference opening project, with its stage ladder Forming, Investigating, Matured, Closed

R8, R21, R25 (fix round 3, C14): each project's question count is its roster row's own, drawn with the project, picking the singular or plural key; a count at zero is not drawn; none is read project by project
R8: a project whose stage is null is drawn undetermined; a list answered truncated says more projects exist
R1, R17 (interface-shell R10): Home's reads drawn loading, failed or with data; an empty read draws no block
R17: an item's own acts on Home send their bodies and re-read the queue, never lookedsince
R1, R25, R30: "Start a project" sends promote with the member's title as a new forming project, written as its title, and opens project on success
R30, R80: the form asks the title and who can find it; neither choice is preselected; none chosen sends nothing and says so; choosing findable sends discoverable
R1, R25: control: with no title nothing is sent and the member is told in the screen's words; a refusal is drawn beside the act
R1 (interface-shell R12): "Start a project" is drawn only to a session that may contribute
R9, R14, R40: "What happened?" draws each door startfrom answers as a button, the sixth door last; a door left out is not drawn
R40: pressing a door sends startfrom for it and opens its offer in place; no script name is drawn before that
R14, R16: with no script offered, the sixth door alone is drawn, so the section is always drawn; its press opens elsewhere, starts no script and sends nothing
R9: startfrom failed is drawn failed in its block; startfrom is a drawn act once it answers doors with scripts
R9: a door's script starts in the wizard runner (cs.wizard) at its version, and sends nothing
R9, R23, R40: beside the doors, the blank start, "Start a project" opening its title field on press; no free-text box and no matching work
R29: a project the member is invited to is hers to do on Home, with Join (projectjoin), as the project's participants answer her place; a joined project offers none
R28: a to-do names its subject by its title, a reference, and its act by the act's label; a subject with no title draws the untitled word
R31: a reply owed by another side whose date has passed is drawn "no reply recorded", never "overdue"; the strip counts no item as overdue
R34: every key Home reads is a word of the list, and what it draws for a sample of its keys equals word(key, vars)
R29, C74: a project the member is invited to is one row on Home though the queue holds its invitation too; an invitation the list does not know is drawn from the queue
R29, C96: two invitations draw two distinct labels, each naming its project
R17, C74: a row's Open opens its subject's screen; a subject that opens nothing draws no Open, not a link to the queue
R64: a home whose fixtures answer each read draws each reading with the read's figure, in its area

R64: edition lines: a case with a draft shared until a date says so, with the recipients' comments to answer; a draft of no case and a lapsed grant say nothing; the latest edition alone is its plain line
R64: controls: a member who is not an administrator sends no securitymap and draws no security level; a read that fails draws its reading failed

outside.waitsOn: store-request: the item in its interface files
tests: R2: the queue is read with the member's chosen sort (time added, time due, case, kind), the route's subject; any other the default
R2: each item drawn by its kind mark (To do, Noticed, Status), grouped by case in the feed's order, with the uncased together
R2, R25: an item's summary and detail are its queue.<kind> words where keyed, filled, else its own summary and detail; the count picks its singular or plural key
R2, R31: due dates drawn with mark.due (a passed date with its date and no word, near, later), and a hint with mark.hint opening in place with what, how, the false-alarm rate and what it is not
R2, R31: due dates are judged on the page's clock (cs.now(), K3002)
R2: the three-kinds note is shown once per member on the device
R3: an item's acts are its options and disposition's doors among the registered acts; any other option is "Open", a link to its subject's screen
R3: each act sends its op's body for the item it was drawn on; an act asking the member's words draws its fields in place
R3: forwarding, a project key and a question from a hint, each with its own field, and nothing sent without it
R2, R3 (interface-shell R10, R13): the queue's four states; a refusal beside its act; an item resolved or muted leaves the list on the re-read
R41 (U8b; DEC-292 D13): with nothing waiting the queue draws the sentence only: no kinds legend, no sort controls, no way-home button
R13 (DEC-212): the unsent-request item draws "Pick up where you left off", "Keep it for later" and "Drop the request, with a reason"
R13: "Drop the request" sends actionmove to abandoned with the member's reason; "Keep it for later" snoozes its case to the chosen day
R18 (queue R19, R20): "Mute a kind" sends the case form {case, kinds}: the item's kind for its nearest home case; an item with no case offers the item mute
R18: control: a to-do offers no mute (queue R31)
R19 (DEC-226 (1)): the update to-do is drawn under its own section with its release and date, "See what changes" and Not now; the security mark when marked
R19: on Home's "Needs you" the update is drawn as home.update.ready, with and without the security mark; control: a member who is not an administrator is answered no such item and none is drawn
R22: five source-modified items draw one item reading "5 documents changed at their source", with the keyed detail, opening the list of its documents, each a reference with its own options
R22: control: a single item draws .one; source-removed is its own item; on Home the same items are one item too
R28: a to-do names its subject by its title, a reference, and its act by the act's label; never a bare address
R31: a reply owed by another side whose date has passed is "no reply recorded" in a row, never "overdue"
R34: every key the queue reads is a word of the list; the retired overdue row is not read
R71: an item whose subject kind has a screen opens it (escalation its matter, key the account); one whose subject opens nothing draws no Open
R73: a bias-debt item's Open opens `bias` at that debt; an item of another kind is unchanged
R74: a tension row opens `contradiction` at its pair; other kinds are unchanged

R74: a conflict the member sees only half of opens `<candidate>/<project>`, the project from `between_projects[0]` (a candidate) or `parties[0]` (a notice), the slash unescaped; control: a whole-seen candidate still opens by its id
R2, C73: after a sort the line names the sort and no longer says the list is grouped by case; by case it still says grouped; the vouch to-dos follow the sort
R3, C75: forwarding is a choice of the group's members; forwarding to oneself is refused in words and sends nothing; one member sends her handle

outside.waitsOn: this module: code the checker accepts under the standard's settings
tests: R2: the queue is read with the member's chosen sort (time added, time due, case, kind), the route's subject; any other the default
R2: each item drawn by its kind mark (To do, Noticed, Status), grouped by case in the feed's order, with the uncased together
R2, R25: an item's summary and detail are its queue.<kind> words where keyed, filled, else its own summary and detail; the count picks its singular or plural key
R2, R31: due dates drawn with mark.due (a passed date with its date and no word, near, later), and a hint with mark.hint opening in place with what, how, the false-alarm rate and what it is not
R2, R31: due dates are judged on the page's clock (cs.now(), K3002)
R2: the three-kinds note is shown once per member on the device
R3: an item's acts are its options and disposition's doors among the registered acts; any other option is "Open", a link to its subject's screen
R3: each act sends its op's body for the item it was drawn on; an act asking the member's words draws its fields in place
R3: forwarding, a project key and a question from a hint, each with its own field, and nothing sent without it
R2, R3 (interface-shell R10, R13): the queue's four states; a refusal beside its act; an item resolved or muted leaves the list on the re-read
R41 (U8b; DEC-292 D13): with nothing waiting the queue draws the sentence only: no kinds legend, no sort controls, no way-home button
R13 (DEC-212): the unsent-request item draws "Pick up where you left off", "Keep it for later" and "Drop the request, with a reason"
R13: "Drop the request" sends actionmove to abandoned with the member's reason; "Keep it for later" snoozes its case to the chosen day
R18 (queue R19, R20): "Mute a kind" sends the case form {case, kinds}: the item's kind for its nearest home case; an item with no case offers the item mute
R18: control: a to-do offers no mute (queue R31)
R19 (DEC-226 (1)): the update to-do is drawn under its own section with its release and date, "See what changes" and Not now; the security mark when marked
R19: on Home's "Needs you" the update is drawn as home.update.ready, with and without the security mark; control: a member who is not an administrator is answered no such item and none is drawn
R22: five source-modified items draw one item reading "5 documents changed at their source", with the keyed detail, opening the list of its documents, each a reference with its own options
R22: control: a single item draws .one; source-removed is its own item; on Home the same items are one item too
R28: a to-do names its subject by its title, a reference, and its act by the act's label; never a bare address
R31: a reply owed by another side whose date has passed is "no reply recorded" in a row, never "overdue"
R34: every key the queue reads is a word of the list; the retired overdue row is not read
R71: an item whose subject kind has a screen opens it (escalation its matter, key the account); one whose subject opens nothing draws no Open
R73: a bias-debt item's Open opens `bias` at that debt; an item of another kind is unchanged
R74: a tension row opens `contradiction` at its pair; other kinds are unchanged

R74: a conflict the member sees only half of opens `<candidate>/<project>`, the project from `between_projects[0]` (a candidate) or `parties[0]` (a notice), the slash unescaped; control: a whole-seen candidate still opens by its id
R2, C73: after a sort the line names the sort and no longer says the list is grouped by case; by case it still says grouped; the vouch to-dos follow the sort
R3, C75: forwarding is a choice of the group's members; forwarding to oneself is refused in words and sends nothing; one member sends her handle
